product_one_liner.value: Open Dental provides customizable dental practice management software for dental practices of any size.

eng_blog.notes: The blog contains product updates, practice advice and an engineering employee interview; no qualifying series of at least two engineer-authored product-building posts was found.

public_docs.notes: Public developer/API documentation is available; comprehensive customer documentation is support-gated.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The active openings are Dental Assistant/Software Support and Daycare Aide; no qualifying AI/ML/data-science title is listed.

model_provider.notes: These are explicitly named third-party AI image-analysis providers integrated into the Imaging Module, not disclosed underlying foundation-model providers.

compliance_certs.notes: Open Dental states that it follows HIPAA security and privacy guidelines and standards; this is a compliance claim, not an independently issued HIPAA certification.

last_funding.notes: The only identified financing is a PPP loan approved April 6, 2020, subsequently forgiven. Tracxn reports no funding rounds; no venture/equity round was identified. The amount is the approved loan principal, not Owler’s rounded estimate or the forgiveness total.

raised_18mo.notes: No funding identified during 2025-05-09 through 2026-11-09; the latest recorded financing is the April 2020 PPP loan.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: No SDR, BDR, sales/business-development representative or account-executive opening appears in the active listings.

launched_6mo.notes: Version 26.1 became stable on 2026-08-06. Its Major Changes include release of ODTouch 25, with new pharmacy functionality, patient-information editing and Ensora eRx support.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No dated C-level or VP join/departure could be verified for 2025-11-09 through 2026-11-09, and no complete official leadership roster with start dates was located.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Integration signal only: the official vendor directory names these CRM systems as supported by the SmartSync connector. This does not establish Open Dental’s internal CRM usage.
